title: Layer size bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $n,T$ be nonnegative integers and $z$ a finite Boolean word. Write $k(M),L(M),K(M)$ for the associated machine quantities and $S=S(M,n,z,T)$ for the associated stride. Define the layer bound to be $k(M)((2T+3)(L(M)+20))+(|z|+n+2)(L(M)+20)+K(M)+9((T+1)S)+6$.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the meanings of k(M), L(M), K(M), and the stride S; x is an argument but does not occur in the defining expression.
